description.narrative: As a response to the overall conflict situation in Ukraine, at the encouragement of EU Member States (Foreign Affairs Council conclusions) this is a proposal to award a grant with an EU contribution of 299 900 EUR to the Black Sea Institute for Strategic Studies (BSISS). The BSISS hosts Black Sea News - the only media outlet in Ukraine covering security developments at the Black and Azov Seas.
